failures_so_far.message:
Expected: String containing "Burning"
  But was:  "You see a torch. A wooden shaft supports a tightly gathered head of fuel. The lower end leaves room for a hand away from the flame.
Controlled flame: Out. Fuel: 50/50 per torch.
Lit held or loose torches use fuel; stowed torches retain their state.
To refuel: extinguish, unequip into your pack, then use lamp oil. One measure adds up to 25 fuel, capped at capacity. Relight beside a burning fire.
Equip slots: Hand.
Tactical use: Hold a lit, dry torch and touch nearby fuel to ignite it. Costs one fuel in addition to the action. Fire can spread; an unlit or stowed torch cannot do this.
Afflicted:
  - Set ablaze - burning at intensity 1 until doused."
